# Impeccable Skill
# Source: https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable
# Description: Design language skill for frontend UI/UX improvement
# License: Apache 2.0

## Overview
Impeccable is a design system skill that helps create exceptional frontend interfaces. 
It provides guidance on visual hierarchy, typography, color, motion, and micro-interactions.

## Core Principles
- Go all out. No hedging, no shortcuts.
- Dream big and bold. Distinct, beautiful, outstanding work.
- Verify in bounded passes, not a loop.

## Key Design Tokens
- Dark lacquer surfaces (warm, not pure black)
- Kinpaku gold as primary accent
- Verdigris patina as secondary accent
- Alumni Sans for display, Albert Sans for body
- Restrained borders, small radii, minimal shadow
